response.sql: WITH per_id AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(ANA) > 0), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_avg FROM per_id) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_ana, p.avg_ana - o.mean_avg AS gap FROM per_id AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_ana > o.mean_avg ORDER BY gap IS NULL, gap DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Rows with a NULL ID do not represent an identifiable patient and are excluded from the per-ID averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat NULL ID as a group when calculating and comparing per-ID averages.
